solaraGrid.verticalReference: Elevation relative to the Mars areoid (MOLA reference). The MOLA+HRSC blend is registered to MOLA topography; HRSC contributes higher planimetric resolution. Treat as derived, vertically aligned to MOLA.
solaraGrid.note: Elevation values are metres (S16, exact integers from the source service). A value of 0 is a measured elevation, not missing data. The source service reports NoData pixels as gaps in coverage; none were detected in this crop (verified min/max within plausible MOLA range).
